title: ASP.NET
body:
Microsoft's server-side web framework, running on .NET with C# as the usual language. Named in
this course alongside [[PHP]] as one of the older, thread-per-request server environments
[[Node.js]] is contrasted with, and as one of the things Node is *not* better at: traditional
dynamic content sites are what it was built for.

The modern version, ASP.NET Core, is cross-platform and does support asynchronous handlers, so
the blocking criticism applies to the classic stack rather than to the name. See
[[Server Side]].
